commands.title: Clipboard history (JavaScript)
commands.subtitle: A JavaScript command that lists the text you copy, once you turn it on

preferences.name: keepHistoryFor
preferences.title: Keep History For
preferences.description: Older items are deleted, also while Pane is stopped or the extension is disabled

preferences.name: pauseRecording
preferences.title: Recording
preferences.label: Pause Recording
preferences.description: While paused, nothing you copy is kept

preferences.name: disabledApplications
preferences.title: Disabled Applications
preferences.description: What you copy in these applications is never kept. Copies an application marks as concealed, as password managers do, are never kept either
